observations: Photo 0 shows five alternators lying on a dirty workshop floor, surrounded by tools and debris. They appear used and dusty, with varying degrees of wear.
Photo 1 is a close-up of one alternator held in hand, showing the front with visible copper windings and a black plastic housing. A small QR code is visible on the housing.
Photo 2 is another close-up of the same alternator from a different angle, showing the top with a black plastic cover, a QR code, and a hand holding it. The alternator has a dusty, used appearance.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on any of the alternators in the photos.
The seller claims compatibility with Mercedes models: C300, GLC300, ML350, GLA250, GLK350.

claims.evidence: No visible part numbers, VIN, or model-specific markings are readable in any photo. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the images alone.
